IGUI_perks_PlayItMusic_Description: Gained by playing an instrument. The higher the level, the fewer wrong notes, and the more your playing cheers up the people listening.
IGUI_PlayIt_BadName: Use letters, digits, spaces, - or _ in the name.
IGUI_PlayIt_NotHolding: Hold the instrument in your main hand to play.
IGUI_PlayIt_Warn_LineTooLong: Line %1 is longer than 300 characters and was skipped.
IGUI_PlayIt_Warn_TooManyLines: Only the first %1 lines are played.
IGUI_PlayIt_TooLong: This song is too long to share with other players. Remove some lines.
IGUI_PlayIt_TooFar: Get closer to the instrument to play.
IGUI_PlayIt_NoSticks: You need a drumstick to play the drums.
IGUI_PlayIt_Busy: Someone else is already playing this.
